questions.title: Museum Club - Part 1

metadata.scenario:
You are a new member of the Museum Club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words. Recommended time: 7 minutes.
Tell me the last time you went to a museum?

questions.stem: You are a member of a museum club. You are talking to three other members in the museum club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.

questions.prompt: Tell a museum you visited when you were a child?
questions.sample_answer: When I was a child, I visited the Vietnam National Museum with my parents. I saw many old objects and learned about Vietnamese history. It was an interesting and memorable experience.

questions.prompt: Which do you prefer, the History Museum or Sports Museum?
questions.sample_answer: I prefer the History Museum because I enjoy learning about famous people and historical events. It helps me understand the past better and gives me a lot of useful knowledge.

questions.prompt: Nowadays, many museums use technology to create online exhibitions. Will that be successful?
questions.sample_answer: Yes, I think it will be successful because people can visit museums from anywhere. Online exhibitions are convenient, save time, and encourage more people to learn about history and culture.
